rows.note: Flag CONFIRMED but the BASE FIGURE in orderwins_signals.json is wrong. The screen used Rs 621 cr 'as on 2026-06-30'. The base document - Om Power's Q1 FY27 investor presentation, filed 12-Aug-2026 - states the walk explicitly on its 'Order Book Status as of Q1FY27' page: order book Rs 621.28 cr as at 31-MARCH-2026, plus Rs 67.82 cr new intake in Q1 FY27, minus Rs 121.63 cr executed, = Rs 567.47 cr as at 30-JUNE-2026. On the correct Rs 567.47 cr base the ratio is 0.641x, HIGHER than the screened 0.585x, and the cross date is unchanged at 2026-10-14. All six order letters were opened and each confirmed on value, awarder, project and date; six distinct projects, no duplicate across BSE/NSE, no L1/LoI re-announcement, no JV or consortium share, no USD conversion. GST caveat: five of the six letters state values INCLUDING GST and one (Hild Projects) excludes it; de-grossing the five at 18% gives Rs 314.30 cr, a ratio of 0.554x - so the flag clears 0.5x on either basis. Customer concentration: GETCO alone is Rs 221.29 cr of the Rs 363.55 cr and Gujarat state utilities (GETCO + UGVCL) are Rs 322.85 cr. Gross book after the wins, before Q2 execution, is about Rs 931 cr against FY26 revenue of Rs 449 cr (2.07x). OMPOWER is already published (card 2026-10-06-OMPOWER, lane filing), so under step 4a-iii it is NOT a new card; the confirmed run is logged as an update on that card instead.
